gaps.sentence: Send your ___ (APPLY) to the address below.
gaps.explanation: 'Your application' — the document you send; an applicant is a person.

gaps.sentence: The new software ___ (ABLE) staff to work securely from anywhere.
gaps.explanation: 'Enable somebody to do something' — the present-tense verb fits the singular subject.

gaps.sentence: They're ___ (HOPE) that the talks will resume.
gaps.explanation: 'Be hopeful that…' = feeling hope; 'hopefully' is the adverb.

gaps.sentence: Last night's ___ (PERFORM) ended with a standing ovation.
gaps.explanation: 'Last night's performance' — the noun for the event.

gaps.sentence: He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.
The programme aims at the ___ (EDUCATE) of young farmers.
The ___ (LONG) of the film is 145 minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'The length' — noun from long (spelling change: long → length).
'Argument' — note the e is dropped from argue.
